Description
  • You can book a study space on campus for one or two hours.
  • Bookings can be made between 8:15am and 10:15pm.
  • The library is open 24 hours a day. You do not need to book spaces in the library after 10:15pm or before 8:15am.
  • All other campus buildings are closed after 10:15pm.
  • You can book up to two hours per day for each category of space.
  • Bookings can be made up to 7 days in advance.

View campus map

Many more study spaces are available with no booking required. Visit go.bath.ac.uk/study-spaces for details.
